title: Lantern Creek Riverbank Survey Handbook

language.typeRulesUnderDefaultLocale: the document declares lang="en"; under the default locale de-DE every run whose language differs from the locale is structurally excluded (docs/rules/type-spaced-hyphen.md 'Limits': 'any run whose lang differs from the locale are structurally excluded, on the ancestor chain')

pages.basis: plain Paged.js measurement (8 pages); one forced break (h2#h-ch4); the fixed grid of section 4 spans three pages whatever the fonts; flowing prose of sections 1-3 and 5-6 may shift by one page

expectedExit.derivation: No error finding: every break-inside: avoid block fits and every SVG label is clear inside with no stroke, so both error rules measure everything (coverage 1). The planted defect is a warn rule, which does not move the exit under the default fail-on error.

byCode.0: clean or warn-only; the stranded heading is warn

expectedExit.environmentNote: Exit 4 with exitReason evidence/required-page-binding-incomplete is an environment failure (evidence binding not supported by the renderer), not an outcome of these documents; run the gate where the live path binds evidence (CI).

fontDependence: Only generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace) are used. Line breaks, paragraph heights and therefore the position of flowing text depend on the fonts the renderer resolves; every construction fact below is built from explicit heights, fixed line pitches, forced breaks or SVG coordinates so that it does not depend on them, and every font-dependent outcome is listed as allowed.
features: inline SVG figures with plain labels
tall break-inside: avoid figure that fits (0.94 of the page)

runningElements.zeroSizeCopyNote: Paged.js also places a copy on these pages, but the @page :first rule sets that margin box to content: none, so the copy is 0 x 0 px and is not counted

constructionFacts.fact: control grid on the next page
constructionFacts.arithmetic: #plate-cover 0..400, #plate-pins 412..892, h3#h-photo-points would be 910..938 (33.33 px left) but break-after: avoid moves it

mustNotFire.why: running element: Paged.js clones it into a page margin box on every page (position: running). Under the release-semantics rule (README 'Release semantics', manifest.json releaseSemantics) content in margin boxes is not in the flow and is not measured by block, line or page rules, so no finding of this rule may name the element or any of its copies.
mustNotFire.docsBasis: README 'Release semantics'; docs/limitations.md, the 'Margin-box content.' bullet (WP-F1, eee9f06); docs/limitations.md 0.6.0 already says 'Blocks carrying the same source id are not always fragments of one flow'.

allowed.why: where a block splits and how many lines each fragment carries depends on font metrics and on Chromium's own widows/orphans handling inside the Paged.js fragmentainer

expectedDeclines.docsBasis: docs/rules/layout-orphan.md 'Skipped after a forced outgoing break'; the widow rule declines after a forced incoming break (declines list in the rule registry).
